queer_characters.name: Orlando
queer_characters.notes: Orlando transforms from male to female across centuries with no in-story explanation, living as both; the film centers a gender-fluid, centuries-spanning existence as its core narrative device.

contributor_notes: Adapted from Virginia Woolf's 1928 novel; explores gender fluidity across historical periods. Orlando's genderfluid tag is drawn from the explicit on-screen transformation and the source text's description of a 'gender-fluid' existence. Director Sally Potter is credited but the source text does not state her own identity, so no creator identity tags were added.
